title: Level classifier network
summary: A 2-D image classifier with a 27-way level head; grey crops are tiled to 3 channels for its stem.
does: One of the eight backbones of tools/train_blocks.py ARCHITECTURES: torchvision's resnet18, resnet34, resnet50, mobilenet-v3-small and efficientnet-b0, MONAI's densenet121, se-resnet50 and se-resnext50. The head has 27 outputs, the LEVELS of src/schwingnet/catalog.py, whatever the data's classes. Grey crops are repeated to 3 channels for the stem, and adaptive pooling lets any crop size through. ImageNet weights come from a file, never a download; the grid holds only resnet18's file, so the experiment route runs resnet18 alone (grid/experiment-driver.sbatch).

outputs.name: model
outputs.what: The network, shaped by the crops it will read.

params.name: weights
params.what: imagenet: the backbone's ImageNet weights from a file (--weights); none: untrained

nondeterminism: The new head starts from a random draw made under its trainer's seed, so the network repeats only with that seed.

generic.why: 2-D torchvision and MONAI networks today (spatial_dims 2, in_channels 3), with grey tiled to 3 channels and a head fixed at the 27 levels; a volume needs a 3-D network (classifier_3d), and other classes need the head read from the data.

resolve: a {family} whose {rank}-D stem takes {sizes.C} channel(s) of {sizes.H} x {sizes.W}; head of {classes}

today.note: resnet18 with ImageNet weights alone on the grid
